blocks.html:
Custom Apparel for Green Mountain Falls' Mountain Village

Green Mountain Falls is one of Colorado's smallest incorporated towns — about 685 residents in a narrow valley at 7,800 feet, tucked below Highway 24 in the Ute Pass corridor west of Colorado Springs. The town centers around Gazebo Lake, and its character blends historic mountain resort, working artists, outdoor recreationists, and full-time residents who chose simplicity over sprawl. Community events, outdoor recreation organizers, and the small businesses here generate demand for custom apparel — especially small-run DTF printing for individual pieces and small gatherings.

Green Mountain Falls is part of Manitou Springs School District 14 along with Cascade, Chipita Park, and surrounding Ute Pass communities. For small-volume orders — a single custom piece or a run of ten — DTF printing with no minimum is the right fit for Green Mountain Falls' scale, and we handle every order with the same attention as a large run. We're just over the hill in Colorado Springs.
